RFC8484-6-2.note: GET data MUST be base64url and carried in the variable 'dns'. Positive TestDoH... GET is answered. The negative TestDoHGetRejectsBadDNSParam sends a missing 'dns' (goes red if another variable name were read) and '*', which is outside both the base64 and base64url alphabets. A server that decoded standard base64 ('+', '/') would still pass: no assertion sends a standard-alphabet value, so the base64url clause is unproven.
